number_rules.economic_scalars: canonical finite base10 string; no exponent, leading zeros, redundant trailing fractional zeros or negative zero
number_rules.unit_conversion: explicit instrument-version and conversion-version; no symbol heuristics
number_rules.sequence: uint64 decimal string, stream-local; no JSON number
number_rules.indicator: decimal text with formula version and absolute tolerance; no implicit float authority

time_rules.encoding: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.ffffffZ; exactly 6 fractional digits; calendar validated; no leap seconds in v1
time_rules.unknown: null is explicit, never synthesized from received_at
time_rules.execution: all six fields mandatory for OrderIntent; available_at and received_at <= features_ready_at <= decision_at <= execution_not_before < expires_at; event_time <= available_at in same validated source timeline

identity_rules.event: source_id + stream_id + sequence; conflicting content rejected
identity_rules.payload_hash: SHA-256 of project canonical ASCII JSON, sorted ASCII property names, exact strings; not a signature
identity_rules.account_state: known/stale/unknown/not_applicable independent of hedging/netting model; OrderIntent requires known

compatibility.unknown_schema: reject command path; quarantine unconverted observations
compatibility.migration: new derived event with adapter version + original provenance; never overwrite historical source
compatibility.legacy_numeric_fields: preserve legacy profile; map percent to fraction only explicitly; cannot recover precision already lost
compatibility.legacy_positions_zero: Old profile positions=0 means budget-governed without count cap: map explicitly to maximum_positions=null, never to new contract 0. Other risk constraints still required; no automatic policy activation.

non_goals: No account-level or cross-host exactly-once claim
open_native_evidence: C# runner included; must be compiled and run before S02-C01 can be recorded pass
